ban_dialog.title: Ban User
ban_dialog.description: This will permanently ban the user from accessing the platform. Provide a reason for the ban.

suspend_dialog.title: Suspend User
suspend_dialog.description: This will temporarily suspend the user's account. Provide a reason for the suspension.

delete_dialog.title: Delete User
delete_dialog.description: This will soft-delete the user account. This action cannot be undone.

activate_dialog.title: Activate User
activate_dialog.description: This will reactivate the user's account, allowing them to log in again.
